overall_summary: Analysis of 14 Shorts reveals strong performance in history trivia and comparative geography/space questions, led by 'Which Came First? History Trivia Quiz!' (137.04% average percentage watched, 47s AVD) and 'Which Country Has The Most Lakes?' (414 views, 67.66% AVP). Abstract or text-heavy math/calendar puzzles suffered lower retention (30.89% AVP). With zero strategy outcome logs available, overall confidence remains low.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Which Came First? History Trivia Quiz!' generated 137.04% AVP, 47s AVD, and 72 estimated minutes watched across 247 views.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more historical timeline and comparative 'Which came first' visual quizzes.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Which Country Has The Most Lakes?' achieved the highest view count (414 views, 67.66% AVP, 16 likes) and 'Which Planet Spins Backwards?' reached 320 views (60.11% AVP).
winning_patterns.action: Double down on clear A/B/C/D multiple-choice quizzes focused on surprising earth and space records.

improvements.pattern: Text-heavy calendar and word trick questions
improvements.evidence: 'Can You Solve This Calendar Trick Question?' dropped to 30.89% AVP and 10s AVD.
improvements.action: Shift focus away from abstract calendar calculations toward visual physics and trivia setups.

improvements.evidence: 'Can You Pass This Tricky Brain Test?' yielded only 1 view and 0% AVP.
improvements.action: Always specify the core topic/subject in the title rather than relying on generic 'brain test' phrasing.

retention_insights.evidence: Audience watch ratio started at 1.9195 (progress 0.01) and remained above 1.3218 at progress 0.49 for 'Which Came First?'.
retention_insights.action: Maintain loopable structured reveals with clear countdowns that encourage re-watching.

retention_insights.evidence: Audience watch ratio plummeted from 1.0588 at 0.01 progress to 0.1765 at 0.49 progress.
retention_insights.action: Simplify question framing visually within the first 3 seconds to prevent early drop-offs.
